risk: 365 lacks authority to display a partner field
preventive_controls: Field-right matrix; counsel review; signed DSA/MOA/licence
treatment: Do not ingest/display until authorized

risk: Previous-owner personal data appears in buyer report
impact: Severe privacy harm; enforcement; trust loss
preventive_controls: Data zones; deny-by-default field policy; redaction; no public raw documents
detective_controls: Automated forbidden-field tests; DLP; report review
treatment: Immediate suppression incident response and correction

risk: Events merge onto wrong or cloned vehicle
preventive_controls: Multi-identifier exact match; conflict queue; no near-match merge
treatment: Suspend asset report and conduct identity review

risk: Government/insurer API credential compromise
preventive_controls: mTLS/private key; short tokens; scoped clients; vault; rotation
detective_controls: SIEM alerting; anomaly and query budget monitoring
treatment: Revoke client notify partner incident procedure

risk: Cross-tenant shop data exposure
preventive_controls: RLS; server authorization; object checks; isolated storage
detective_controls: Automated cross-tenant tests; access anomaly alerts
treatment: Contain assess notify and remediate

risk: VIN/plate enumeration used for stalking or fraud
preventive_controls: Purpose/owner checks; masks; rate limits; no wildcard; report limits
treatment: Block users/devices investigate and tune controls

risk: No-result is presented as clean history
preventive_controls: Mandatory language; source coverage and unavailable states
detective_controls: Usability tests; report QA; complaint monitoring
treatment: Correct UI notify affected purchasers as policy requires

risk: Purchase is shown as installation
preventive_controls: Separate state machines; technician confirmation; RO link
treatment: Withdraw event review contributor

risk: Shop fabricates repair or mileage events
impact: Market trust and vehicle value harm
preventive_controls: Business/technician verification; evidence; signed submissions; quality rewards
detective_controls: Pattern analytics; complaint/comeback and evidence audits
treatment: Suspend contributor correct events investigate

risk: Accurate negative events are hidden for payment
preventive_controls: Non-negotiable policy; independent evidence grade; contract terms
treatment: Reinstate event terminate abuse and notify as needed

risk: Insurer event implies driver fault or unsupported severity
preventive_controls: Approved categories only; no blame; source wording
treatment: Suppress/correct and review field mapping

risk: 365 implies LTO/HPG endorsement before approval
impact: Agency relationship and public trust harm
preventive_controls: Claim approval policy; no logos; controlled templates
treatment: Remove claim notify agency if appropriate retrain

risk: Disputes exceed staffing capacity
impact: Incorrect events remain public; customer harm
preventive_controls: Volume caps; service targets; trained reviewers; urgent triage
treatment: Pause report expansion add staff suppress urgent events

risk: 365 cannot assess/notify within applicable deadline
preventive_controls: IR plan; DPO/counsel; processor clauses; tabletop
treatment: Escalate incident commander and external support

risk: Backups are unavailable or corrupted
preventive_controls: Encrypted backups; separation; point-in-time protection
treatment: Failover/restore and root-cause remediation

risk: Document extraction creates a false public event
preventive_controls: AI output is draft; evidence retained; human/authority validation
detective_controls: Confidence and reviewer audits; dispute monitoring
treatment: Suppress event correct model/workflow

risk: Foreign source rights or privacy terms are applied to wrong country
preventive_controls: Country adapters; territorial entitlements; no fallback
detective_controls: Country/source coverage tests and field-policy logs
treatment: Disable source in affected territory

risk: Partner per-query cost destroys report margin
preventive_controls: Cost model; preview; quotas; source-specific pricing
treatment: Reprice/bundle/change source without degrading truth

risk: Source changes schema or withdraws data without notice
preventive_controls: Versioned adapters; change notice; contract; fail closed
treatment: Disable affected fields show unavailable remediate

risk: Overbroad future guarantee creates uninsurable liability
preventive_controls: No MVP buyback promise; narrow terms; underwriting; reserves
treatment: Suspend guarantee and handle claims per terms

risk: Report PDF/screenshot is altered or reused
preventive_controls: Hash/QR validation; watermark; expiry; immutable snapshot
detective_controls: Validation mismatch and unusual download monitoring
treatment: Warn buyer mark invalid investigate account

risk: Exact recent shop/time reveals vehicle location
preventive_controls: Generalize date/location; hide recent locations; purpose controls
detective_controls: Privacy review and access anomaly monitoring
treatment: Suppress affected events and reassess display rules

risk: Government partnership stalls for more than 12 months
preventive_controls: Independent 365-owned MVP; private partnerships; staged roadmap
treatment: Continue shop/parts/scan value and revisit with pilot evidence

risk: Public calls product a CARFAX copy or complete database
preventive_controls: Distinct positioning; installed-part lifecycle; limitations
treatment: Correct wording and publish factual comparison

risk: Malicious evidence file compromises reviewer or leaks metadata
preventive_controls: Isolated upload; malware scan; quarantine; redacted derivatives
treatment: Quarantine revoke access incident review
